name: Provisional LHRe 130s5p P30B / EMRAX 228 HV powertrain
status: Replace pack curves and inverter settings with the validated battery architecture model before design decisions.

sources.molicel_p30b: https://www.molicel.com/product/inr-18650-p30b/ (current product page: 3.0 Ah, 3.6 V nominal, 36 A discharge, 47 g)
sources.pack_topology: Existing local Orion powertrain analysis; confirm with Battery.
sources.ocv_curve: Provisional smooth NMC approximation anchored at public 2.5 V minimum, 3.6 V nominal, and 4.2 V charge voltage.
sources.cell_resistance: Provisional effective value carried from the existing local 0.1876946944 ohm 130s5p pack estimate.
sources.motor_inductance_note: EMRAX v1.6 publishes one 225.5 uH phase inductance. This surface-PMSM implementation provisionally sets Lq equal to Ld.
sources.pack_mass_sweep: The 5p vehicle is the zero-delta baseline. Other parallel counts apply cell-count delta times the provisional 1.25 pack mass multiplier.
sources.inverter_and_iron_loss: Explicit engineering placeholders carried from the existing local Orion envelope; replace with controller map.
